comments.body: CI stale check caught a missed YAML change on the first try. Merged.

content.text: CI stale check caught a missed YAML change on the first try. Merged.

The billing portal session create endpoint (POST /v1/billing/portal-sessions) has an OpenAPI path but clients still hand-write request and response types. Drift between the YAML and TypeScript caused two production 400s last quarter when returnUrl became required.

Generate TypeScript types from the OpenAPI document into packages/billing-api-types using openapi-typescript, export CreatePortalSessionRequest and CreatePortalSessionResponse, and wire the portal client to consume them. Add a CI check that fails if the generated file is stale relative to the YAML.
Done when the generator runs in the billing package build, consumers import from @nimbus/billing-api-types, and the stale-check job is green on main.
